works.title: Oracle
works.description: An anonymous AI-powered spiritual/intelligence system designed for serendipitous knowledge distribution. Combines autonomic spiritual co-processing, a Function-First Recomposition Engine for product utility discovery, federation of distributed intelligences, cosmology simulation (God Space), and a sophisticated anonymity + operational-security architecture for untraceable global distribution via OracleStream transmission protocol.
works.quote: This is the kind of design solution my Oracle project would put out.

works.title: Fox News Propaganda Book
works.description: A satirical/documentary book about disingenuous bullshitters inside Fox News, modeled on the UK Office's cringe-comedy style. Uses micro-betrayals and workplace dynamics to reveal how propaganda is manufactured and truth disappears through incremental rationalization rather than deliberate conspiracy. Characters include a true believer, a stats nerd who realizes their job is manufacturing permission, and others who gradually see the mission as careerism.
works.quote: I've been working on a book idea about disingenuous self-serving bullshitters where I take a candid look at the inside of Fox News.
